temporal_state_chain.observed: Shirley appears somber at the funeral, says the loss has been tough, keeps thinking about whether more could have been done, and finds it hard to let go.

temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—seeing Shirley's somber demeanor and hearing her struggle to let go confirms Shirley is deeply affected.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is grieving the patient's death and is deeply affected by the loss.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Shirley seems improved, says she feels better thanks to their talks and Sara's support, and agrees to spend time together outside work.

temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Shirley confirms she is feeling better and is open to further social support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is doing better, their support has helped, and Shirley is receptive to spending more time together.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to continue supporting Shirley and to plan time together for the weekend
